svg.aria-label: The gcd trick added to the knapsack
svg.title: The gcd trick added to the knapsack
svg.text: Faster knapsack: count in 10 MB blocks, not 1 MB
Example cache of 100 MB, videos of 50, 50, 80 and 30 MB. Every size is a multiple of 10.
↓ divide every size and the capacity by 10, their gcd (the biggest number that divides them all) ↓
After: one column per 10 MB block
Why the answer is the same: with sizes that are all multiples of 10, a used amount like 37 MB can never happen, so those columns were wasted.
The commit message reports up to 5000× faster on data sets where every video has the same size.
